description:
Linus Sweeney, who is in the spotlight wherever he goes with his handsome looks and a genius brain, and Peter Mack, a natural nerd who tenaciously digs into anything since he was young. Their contact was almost non-existent until Peter achieved the feat of hacking Caltech. Linus throws a party at a famous club to celebrate Peter's great achievement. Aside from his hacking skills, the nerdy Peter grabs Linus' attention. 

Linus "kindly" takes care of Peter, who loses conscious due to the drugs and alcohol Linus had given him. The two begin seeing each other, spending most of their time together, and their relationship continues for three years. But one day, Linus ruthlessly turns his back on Peter without telling him why.

Eight years later, Peter, who has overcome the pain of a broken heart, has become a CIA agent. He is assigned to a mission which unexpectedly leads to meeting Linus once again at a mental hospital. Peter tries to control his feelings, but whenever he sees Linus approaching him and hears his whispered sweet words, his heart melts.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
